jobs.title: Operations Manager, Global Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
Founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016, Thrive Global is a leading behavior change technology company with the mission to improve productivity and health outcomes – one Microstep at a time. Thrive helps individuals and organizations improve well-being, performance and mental resilience with its AI-powered behavior change technology platform. Thrive’s Microsteps – small, science-backed steps to improve health and productivity – have been adopted by employees at more than 230 organizations in over 160 countries, from frontline and call center workers to executives at multinational companies. For more information, visit www.thriveglobal.com.

The Operations Manager oversees the day-to-day delivery of one of Thrive’s largest global enterprise accounts. This role manages a distributed team of Wellbeing Coordinators and directs the work of contract Health Coaches assigned to the account.

The Operations Manager enables coordinators and coaches to execute campaigns, live sessions, and other program activities across regions. They establish clear expectations, resolve operational issues, and maintain consistent quality while accommodating local needs. This role partners closely with the Program Manager on delivery plans and capacity, the Account Director on account priorities and escalations, and the Director of Coaching Operations on coaching standards and quality.

The Program Manager owns what the program delivers and when. The Operations Manager owns how it is delivered, who delivers it, and whether the team has sufficient capacity. Any unresolved conflicts or competing priorities are escalated to the Account Director.

**How You'll Contribute**

**Lead the Delivery Team**

* Hire, onboard, manage, and develop the global team of Wellbeing Coordinators.
* Set clear responsibilities and expectations, give regular feedback, and address performance concerns.
* Lead the contract coaching team day to day: set program goals, define what success looks like, give clear guidance on live events (what to present, when, and how), and align coaches' work to account strategy.
* Assign and schedule coaches across coaching, live sessions, and fitness classes.
* Run regular team meetings and 1:1s with coordinators and coaches.
* Manage workloads and coverage across regions and time zones.
* Develop areas of specialty within the coordinator team while maintaining coverage for core responsibilities.

**Manage Program Delivery**

* Own the delivery standards for how events, outreach, and results are scheduled, tracked, and reported across all regions. Approved regional flexibility sits within those standards.
* Oversee the day-to-day delivery of campaigns, webinars, events, employee communications, coaching, and community activities.
* Work with coordinators and coaches to turn the program roadmap into regional delivery plans, clear priorities, and operational goals.
* Build the templates, checklists, and playbooks coordinators use to prepare and run scheduled activities, and hold the team accountable to them.
* Maintain processes that support consistent delivery across regions.
* Spot delivery issues early and coordinate a quick response for the client and participants.

**Own Capacity and Operational Decisions**

* Track team availability, coaching utilization, and upcoming delivery commitments so the Program Manager can plan against capacity.
* Record what was delivered against contracted commitments and provide operational data to the Program Manager for client reviews.
* Monitor how each type of program activity (workshops, movement classes, webinars, tabling) performs by region, and own decisions on regional programming mix within the roadmap. Bring recommendations that change the roadmap to the Program Manager.
* Resolve day-to-day delivery issues. Flag requests that would change program priorities to the Program Manager, and changes to account scope or resources to the Account Director.
* Maintain the account’s operational playbook, including procedures, onboarding materials, and escalation paths.
* Maintain the team’s operational trackers and coordinate access to Thrive and client systems with IT and Security.

**Oversee Coaching Operations and Partners**

* Partner with the Director, Coaching Operations, who owns coach certification, coaching methodology, quality standards, coaching product operations (booking and platform issues), coaching usage reporting, and coachee pipeline and retention. The Operations Manager owns coach leadership, live event guidance, program mix, and regional programming decisions.
* Manage the day-to-day relationship and budget for coaching vendors and contractors, partnering with People and Legal on contracts and scope of work.
* Manage the day-to-day business relationship with coaching vendors and contractors, partnering with People and Legal on contracts and scope of work.
* Make sure assignments stay within each contractor’s agreed scope and route performance concerns through the appropriate channels.

**Improve Delivery Quality**

* Monitor service quality, participant feedback, and team performance.
* Work with the Program Manager to address recurring delivery issues and bring regionalfeedback into future plans.
* Improve workflows and team practices to make delivery more reliable and improve the participant experience.
* Partner with the Director, Coaching Operations on coaching quality concerns.

**Who You Are**

* You’re an empathetic people leader who sets clear expectations, gives useful feedback, and helps teams grow.
* You give regional teams room to make local decisions while maintaining consistent standards.
* You can coordinate employees and contract coaches to deliver a complex program reliably.
* You take ownership of delivery quality and look for practical ways to improve it.
* Decision Rights
* You decide: coach and coordinator assignments, scheduling and coverage, regional programming mix within the roadmap, delivery process changes
* You recommend: roadmap

Description:

**WHO WE ARE**

ZBeta is a world-class physical security design, consulting, and managed services firm that partners with some of the most dynamic, high-profile organizations and individuals in the world. We leverage a Data-Driven, Technology-Led, Human-Centered approach in order to help our clients architect and engineer superior physical security solutions, implement them seamlessly, and operate them at peak efficiency. ZBeta prides itself on its level of technical expertise but remains independent and product-agnostic. Our highly experienced team brings decades of security expertise, diverse organizational perspectives, and proven best practices to every project and customer. It is our meticulous attention to detail, and our ability to deliver at scale that positions us to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Our primary goal is to redefine the standards of professional security, equipping our clients with innovative tools to master today’s challenges and fortify against tomorrow's risks. By consistently delivering exceptional solutions and pioneering advancements in the security field, we can exceed expectations and set new standards of excellence in pursuing our vision.

Find out more about us here.

**WHO YOU ARE**

You are a forward-thinking strategic partner with a passion for enhancing security measures and fostering community resilience. You excel in fast-paced settings where your leadership abilities can catalyze meaningful transformation. You thrive in a workplace culture that is:

* Innovative
* Strives for Excellence
* Reliable
* Detail Oriented
* Adaptable
* Highly Organized
* Client Obsessed
* Curious
* Resilient

Does this sound like you? If so, join us in our mission to redefine security standards and make a lasting difference in our community.

You will serve as the primary project manager from project initiation through design completion, ensuring projects remain aligned with client objectives, schedules, budgets, and quality expectations.

This role requires a unique combination of business acumen, communication, leadership, strategy development, tactical ability, and project management skills. You are a resourceful, knowledgeable, and self-motivated security professional who thrives in a collaborative and supportive environment.

* **Growth Minded:** Strong self-awareness of strengths and development areas with a curiosity and appetite for change and innovation
* **Data-Driven:** Strong analytical skills with critical thinking driven by data
* **Collaborative**: Ability to solicit and understand multiple perspectives
* **Evaluative:** Ability to evaluate outputs rigorously to ensure consistent excellence in delivery
* **Strategic Thinker:** Ability to think proactively about the future of the business and relate current business activities to desired outcomes

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

The essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

**Project Management**

* Identify project schedule, scope parameters, and oversee security design and implementation per client design requirements and standards.
* Manage early project initiation activities and develop project security scope, schedule, critical deliverables, and requirements.

**Design**

* Serve as a primary security point of contact for project teams and stakeholders.
* Attend regular project design, project management, Owner/Architect/Contractor (OAC), and construction meetings.
* Manage site activation activities for physical security amongst project parties and stakeholders to drive schedule, quality, and cost.
* Coordinate with ZBeta design resources to develop the complete scope of work documents for security systems procurement and installation.

**Documentation**

* Produce project status and issues reports and meet with client stakeholders weekly to review and resolve high-priority project issues.
* Log all instances of issue resolutions that constitute exceptions to the published client security requirements to facilitate effective requirements exceptions reporting and/or requirement document updates.

**Quality Control**

* Review security system designs for technical accuracy, constructability, and compliance with client standards.
* Coordinate internal quality assurance reviews prior to client delivery.

The work supports Army installations in reconciling GIS and Real Property records, improving data quality, developing automated validation tools, and delivering practical mapping and analytical solutions.

* Oversee the implementation of payment-processing solutions for new merchant accounts.
* Coordinate merchant onboarding, account setup, and system configuration.
* Work with sales, support, and technical teams to plan implementation timelines.
* Help coordinate point-of-sale equipment setup, payment terminals, and e-commerce integrations.
* Track implementation milestones and resolve delays.
* Communicate with merchants about requirements, timelines, and next steps.
* Coordinate testing and confirm that payment systems are functioning as expected.
* Help troubleshoot implementation issues and escalate technical problems when needed.
* Maintain accurate implementation records and project updates.
* Support merchant training and the transition to ongoing account support.
* Monitor implementation performance and identify opportunities to improve the process.

You should be comfortable managing multiple projects, communicating with clients, coordinating across departments, and working through technical or operational issues.

jobs.title: Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Opportunity:**

  

We’re seeking an organized, strategic, customer-focused Onboarding Manager to own the onboarding lifecycle for our multifamily real estate partners: Property Management Companies (PMCs), Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), regional operations leaders, and onsite community teams.

You’ll lead onboarding from start to finish. That covers the post-sales handoff, account configuration, software integrations, onsite staff training, and early adoption across newly launched property portfolios. During rollout you’ll be the operational anchor, making sure each implementation meets technical, operational, and service-level agreement (SLA) standards. You’ll also keep Sales, Client Success, Field Operations, and Product aligned throughout, so every new portfolio sees value fast.

The ideal candidate is an onboarding expert who has run complex, multi-stakeholder rollouts for enterprise clients and knows how to turn new customers into confident users. Strong technical implementation skills are a must, and experience in multifamily real estate is a plus.

This is an individual contributor role with room to grow as the Onboarding function expands. You’ll improve client retention, shorten time-to-value, and speed up the handoff to Client Success, all while refining the process as you go. Along the way, you’ll help build the operational standards and processes that let Onboarding scale.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Onboarding & Implementation**

* Own onboarding for newly contracted properties, regional rollouts, and portfolio acquisitions, from the sales handoff through the first 90 days after launch.
* Build implementation plans, milestone schedules, and kickoff meetings with regional VPs, Asset Managers, and onsite Community Managers.
* Coordinate technical setup, data migration, and integrations with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, ResMan, and AppFolio.
* Make sure community profiles and property access credentials are set up accurately before go-live.
* Lead virtual and onsite training for Regional Managers, Property Managers, Leasing Consultants, and Maintenance teams.

**Client Experience**

* Serve as the primary contact and escalation point during the 90-day onboarding window, and diagnose and resolve implementation issues quickly.
* Build trust with VPs of Property Operations, Asset Managers, and Regional VPs by tying the platform to the metrics they care about: NOI, occupancy, and resident retention.
* Run implementation reviews and post-launch health checks to drive adoption and catch churn risk early.
* Track SLA compliance, setup turnaround, CSAT, and early adoption, and act on warning signs before they turn into escalations.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Run formal sales-to-onboarding handoffs to confirm scope, custom contract terms, and client expectations.
* Get Field Operations, Logistics, and Support aligned on property readiness ahead of each go-live.
* Bring client feedback, feature requests, and bug escalations to Product and Engineering.
* Keep Salesforce and project tools accurate so leadership has clear portfolio reporting.

**Process Improvement & Enablement**

* Find recurring friction points and turn the fixes into SOPs, playbooks, and launch checklists that help onboarding scale.
* Create client-facing onboarding materials and training guides built around multifamily workflows.
* Lead workflow automation projects in Salesforce, project management tools, and ticketing systems, partnering with Revenue Operations.
* Act as the team’s subject matter expert on onboarding, sharing best practices with Client Success team members.

### **What Success Looks Like:**

In your first year, success means:

* New properties go live on schedule, meet SLAs, and start with strong satisfaction and health scores.
* The playbooks, SOPs, and automations you build are adopted across Client Services.
* You resolve complex, multi-property launch issues on your own and keep internal teams on track through tight timelines.
* Teammates count on you as a go-to resource for onboarding.

### **What You'll Need:**

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years in client onboarding or implementation at a B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services company.
* A track record of leading enterprise or multi-location rollouts from handoff to adoption, including building the playbooks and SOPs behind them.
* Experience coordinating software integrations or data migrations with clients and technical teams.
* Strong organization. You can manage dozens of rollouts at once without letting quality slip, and you use data to spot and fix problems.
* Clear communication, from presenting to executives to explaining complex workflows to non-technical staff.
* Comfort with ambiguity and changing tools, plus hands-on experience with CRM, project management, and support platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, Kustomer).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Multifamily real estate experience, whether in onsite or regional property operations (e.g., Community Manager) or at a PropTech vendor, ideally with NMHC Top 50 owners/operators.
* Experience with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, AppFolio, or ResMan.
* Experience with Salesforce Flow or custom intake forms.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, Communications, or a related field.

**Core Competency Profile**

* **Project Management:** Highly organized with superior attention to detail; capable of managing dozens of simultaneous property rollouts without sacrificing quality.
* **Customer-Centric Leadership:** Empathetic listener and skilled communicator capable of simplifying complex workflows for non-technical property staff.
* **Problem-Solving & Agility:** Able to navigate ambiguity, overcome technical blockers, and build constructive relationships across diverse internal and external stakeholders.

### **What We'll Deliver On:**

  

* Competitive base salary plus performance bonus potential

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
Points North is looking for a Senior Program Manager who is excited to support the way a growing, 60-person SaaS company gets its most important work done. This is not a PMO role where you install a methodology and police it. It is a hands-on role at a company that has grown on the strength of good people and good instincts and now needs just enough structure to keep that working as we take on bigger things: major product launches, company-wide initiatives, and a brand-new product experiment that needs an owner.

You will report to the VP of Engineering, but you will serve with the whole company. Product and Engineering, then Sales, Customer Success, Client Support, Implementation, Operations, Managed Services, Finance, Marketing, and People and Culture. You will be evolving program and project governance from close to zero, which means you get to decide what good looks like here, and you get to live with the results.

If you are the kind of person who believes the best process is the one nobody notices because it just works, who has seen heavyweight frameworks slow good teams down and has no interest in importing one, and who is as comfortable owning a product backlog as you are running a cross-functional launch, we want to talk to you.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Enhance lightweight program and project governance for Product and Engineering, and then for the company. Collaboratively structure and then document how work gets proposed, prioritized, tracked, and finished. Build the minimum that gives leaders the visibility and teams the clarity they need, and then defend that minimum against the natural pull toward more.
* Run our largest cross-functional initiatives end to end. Major product launches, operational improvement projects, and company-wide changes that touch every department. Own the plan, the dependencies, the risks, the communication, and the follow-through, so that the people doing the work know what they need to do and can focus on the work.
* Support the adoption of AI tools across the company. Not a mandate from above, but a real program: find where AI tooling makes people measurably more effective, help teams try it, learn what works, and spread it. Use AI yourself as a force multiplier in how you plan, communicate, and analyze.
* Be the Product Owner for an early-stage product experiment. We have one engineer dedicated to an early-stage internal tool that may have wider market opportunities. For at least the next six to twelve months, you will own the product side of that experiment: talk with internal and external stakeholders to vet which problems are worth solving, decide how to solve them and in what order, write clear requirements the engineer can build from, and build the evidence for whether there is a larger market. If it succeeds, we will hire a dedicated product manager to hand off to, and you will continue as our Senior Program Manager.
* Make priorities visible and tradeoffs explicit. Help leadership see what is in flight, what is competing for the same people, and what it costs to say yes to something new. Bring data and a point of view and let the executives make the call with clear information.
* Facilitate the Agile events and rituals that earn their keep. Planning, reviews, retrospectives, and the rhythms that keep teams aligned, tuned to what actually helps the team ship rather than what a framework prescribes.
* Build the operating cadence for the company. Quarterly planning, status reporting that people actually read, decision logs, and the handful of templates that make the next project easier than the last one. Document it well enough that it runs without you in the room.
* Partner with every function. Spend real time with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Implementation, Operations, Managed Services, Finance, Marketing, and People and Culture. Understand how each team works before suggesting how it could work better.
* Close the loop. When an initiative finishes, find out whether it delivered what it promised based on the metrics and success criteria established at kickoff. Run honest retrospectives and share what you learn to improve how we run the next one.
* Continuously learn and grow, in program management, in product thinking, and in how you help a company get better at getting things done.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* A practical thinker who knows the goal is a company that executes well, not a governance model for its own sake.
* A builder of just-enough process. Someone who has seen both ends of the spectrum, chaos and bureaucracy, and has a practiced instinct for the lightweight middle. You know that a process which is not followed is worse than no process at all.
* A practitioner of real Agile software development. You have worked inside teams that actually ship this way, and you understand the principles well enough to adapt the practices to the team instead of forcing the team to fit the practices.
* Someone with enough product instinct to own a product. You can sit with a customer, hear a problem underneath the request, decide what to build first, and write a requirement an engineer can act on without a meeting to decode it.
* A strong communicator who can brief an executive in two minutes, run a working session with a sales or operations team, and write a status update that people read all the way to the end. You follow up on your commitments and your questions.
* Someone who is enthusiastic about AI as an enabler, eager to experiment with AI-assisted tooling in your own work and to help others do the same, without abdicating judgment.
* A collaborator who earns trust across departments by being useful, not by holding authority. People should want you in the room because things go better when you are there.
* Someone who takes pride in enabling others and finds real satisfaction in a team finishing something big and knowing that your work under them made it easier.

* 10+ years of experience in program m

jobs.description:
**About Brightway**

Established in 2008, Brightway is proud to be one of the fastest-growing insurance agency systems in the United States. With over 350 franchises spanning 35+ states and an impressive $1.3 billion in annual premiums, we rank among the nation’s largest privately owned property and casualty insurance distribution companies. We support our agency owners with comprehensive back-office services, marketing resources, and continuous learning and development.

We are embarking on the next stage of our customer-centric growth, driven by innovation from our talented associates and the application of cutting-edge technologies. This growth has opened doors for creative thinkers who thrive in a diverse and collaborative culture. As a Brightway team member, you'll engage in exciting projects that are reshaping the industry, working alongside a dedicated team committed to delivering exceptional customer service and safeguarding our clients' most valuable assets.

-

**Scope**

Brightway is seeking an Agency Acquisitions Project Manager to own end-to-end project management for agency and book acquisitions from Letter of Intent (LOI) through close. As the operational backbone of Brightway’s M&A program, this role ensures every acquisition—whether a franchise conversion or a jointly structured book purchase—moves efficiently from signed LOI to a fully integrated, closed deal.

This role sits at the intersection of operations, carrier relations, and cross-functional coordination. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, detail-oriented project manager who can manage multiple concurrent deals, hold internal and external partners accountable to deadlines, and keep closings on track. This position offers regular visibility to Brightway’s leadership team and the opportunity to help scale a critical growth function.

The primary objective of this role is to accelerate deal closings and reduce the time from LOI to close by managing the full lifecycle of each acquisition with rigor, urgency, and clear communication.

**Role Overview**

The Agency Acquisitions Project Manager leads each acquisition through the post-LOI process. Brightway’s M&A program includes two primary deal types:

* Franchise Conversions — Brightway acquires an independent agent’s book of business, and the agent converts their existing agency into a Brightway franchise.
* Book Acquisitions — Brightway jointly purchases a book of business with an existing Brightway franchisee.

Across both deal types, this role coordinates due diligence, gathers policy-level and carrier information, ensures data is organized and delivered to the QC team for entry into the agency management system, and drives all workstreams through closing.

**Job Responsibilities**

1. Deal Project Management

* Own the project plan, milestone timeline, and deal calendar for each active acquisition from LOI through close.
* Maintain a master deal tracker with status, open items, owners, dependencies, and target close dates.
* Manage process checklists and keep all workstreams moving in parallel.
* Proactively identify risks, remove roadblocks, and escalate complex issues to the right stakeholders with a clear path to resolution.
* Act as the primary post-LOI point of contact for internal stakeholders, external partners, and acquisition participants.

2. Due Diligence Coordination

* Collect, organize, and track all due diligence materials required to evaluate, process, and close each deal.
* Follow up with agents, carriers, and internal teams to ensure materials are complete and received on time.
* Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation for each acquisition.

3. Carrier Coordination & Policy Data

* Partner with Brightway’s carrier team and, when needed, carriers directly to obtain policy lists and book-level information for each acquired book of business.
* Track carrier appointment transfers and code migrations required to bring new agents into Brightway’s systems.
* Learn and document carrier-specific processes for book transfers to ensure consistency and replicability across deals.

4. QC & System Integration

* Compile and present policy information to the QC team in the format required for entry into the agency management system.
* Monitor data completeness and accuracy; flag discrepancies and work with relevant parties to resolve.
* Ensure a seamless handoff to the QC and onboarding teams so each deal closes cleanly and transitions smoothly.

5. Agent Communication & Onboarding Support

* Serve as a key point of contact for incoming agents during the acquisition process, setting clear expectations and providing timely updates.
* Conduct orientation calls with new agents as needed to explain the appointment and migration process.
* Manage inbound requests from internal and external partners and follow up on action items appropriately.

**Skills, Licenses, Certifications**

* Strong project management skills, including the ability to build and manage timelines, own deliverables, and drive work to completion across multiple concurrent deals.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in a high-stakes environment.
* Strong communicator able to convey information clearly and concisely to agents, carriers, and senior leadership.
* Proactive, service-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.
* Ability to understand and navigate insurance carrier processes and operations.
* Strong independent judgment and sound decision-making under time pressure.
* Excellent time management skills, with the ability to prioritize across a portfolio of active deals and manage competing demands.
* Team player who can both contribute independently and rely on cross-functional colleagues to move deals forward.
* Demonstrates Brightway values of Smart, Accountable, and Trustworthy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint); experience with CRM, workflow, or project management tools is a plus.

jobs.title: Civil Aviation Management Expert/Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Organizational Setting

Under the ICAO Capacity Development and Implementation Directorate (CDI), the Operations Section (FOS) is responsible for the strategic planning, development, execution, and evaluation of projects. FOS supports the identification of priority development needs in the civil aviation sector and offers technical cooperation to recipient States. FOS executes projects in accordance with ICAO/CDI policies and contractual modalities.

ICAO/CDI is supporting the Government of the Republic of Armenia in the institutional reform of the Civil Aviation Committee (CAC), as established in Project Document ARM24802. This project is implemented under the Management Service Agreement (MSA) signed between ICAO and the Government of Armenia on 8 March 2024.

Within this framework, the project provides structured technical assistance to transform the current CAC from a government department operating within civil service constraints into an autonomous, technically competent, and financially sustainable authority fully capable of fulfilling its safety oversight mandate in accordance with ICAO Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs).

In addition, this project aims to support the necessary institutional reforms to increase effectiveness, sustainability, and independence of the AASIID.

**TECHNIAL CONTEXT**

Armenia's civil aviation sector is currently regulated by the Civil Aviation Committee (CAC), a government body operating within the State civil service framework. The CAC faces structural challenges that constrain its effectiveness as a safety oversight body: it operates under civil service HR frameworks that limit its ability to attract and retain qualified technical specialists; it is dependent on the state budget with limited cost-recovery mechanisms; and its primary legislation and regulatory framework require updating to align with applicable ICAO SARPs.

ICAO's Universal Safety Oversight Audit Program (USOAP) findings have identified gaps in Armenia's safety oversight capabilities that can only be sustainably resolved through fundamental institutional reform. The Government of Armenia, in cooperation with ICAO, has committed to transforming the CAC into an autonomous CAC capable of fulfilling its safety oversight mandate on a sustainable basis and to increase effectiveness, sustainability, and independence of the AASIID.

Project ARM24802 supports this transformation through three integrated reform pillars: (i) Institutional and Legislative Reform — establishing the legal, regulatory, and governance framework for an autonomous CAC and independent AASIID; (ii) Organizational, Administrative and Functional Review — restructuring the institution's organization, processes, and manuals; and (iii) Sustainable Financing and Human Resources Framework — establishing cost-recovery mechanisms and a competitive HR framework to attract and retain qualified staff.

**Major duties and Responsibilities**

In general terms, the activities contemplated in Project ARM24802 in which all team members will contribute include the following:

* Diagnostic Phase: Assessment of the current CAC's and AASIID’s legal, institutional, organizational, financial, and HR frameworks; review of USOAP findings and national legislative context.

* Reform Design Phase: Development of reform recommendations, legislative drafts, organizational models, financial frameworks, and HR policies aligned with ICAO SARPs, related guidance and best practices. as applicable.

* Implementation Support Phase: Technical assistance to CAC and AASIID in implementing approved reforms, including staff capacity building and stakeholder engagement.

Function 1 (incl. Expected results)

* Lead and coordinate the work of the expert team, ensuring coherent and timely delivery across all three reform pillars and all project objectives.
* Oversee all project activities and deliverables in close coordination with the ICAO CDI and ICAO EUR/NAT Responsible Officers and the National Project Coordinator.
* Conduct a senior-level diagnostic assessment of the current CAC as an institution, covering governance, management, accountability, and operational performance.
* Develop the overall CAC reform design, including governance model, management structure, board or advisory committee arrangements, accountability mechanisms, and transition strategy.
* Advise on CAC operational management models: strategic planning, performance management, regulatory decision-making, and reporting frameworks.
* Lead high-level stakeholder engagement with the Ministry, current CAC and AASIID senior leadership, other Government entities, as applicable.
* Develop the CAC Transition Strategy and Implementation Roadmap, integrating legal, financial, organizational, and HR reform components.
Ensure quality and coherence across all project deliverables, reviewing and integrating contributions from all five experts.

Function 2 (incl. Expected results)

* Coordinate the duties of all experts as a Project Coordinator to achieve the project objectives to the best of their ability.
* When necessary, contribute to the review and harmonization of sections developed by other members of the expert team.
* Compile the necessary documentation to carry out the work.
* Prepare meetings and field visits appropriately, including preparing lists of stakeholders to be consulted, questionnaires, and corresponding visit and meeting reports.
* Participate in coordination meetings organized by the ICAO CDI and EUR/NAT Responsible Officers and the National Project Coordinator.
* Ensure that ICAO's safety, security, and sustainability considerations applicable to the various work areas are incorporated into all deliverables.
* Prepare and coordinate with other experts the development of a detailed work plan with delivery dates and responsibilities for each team member.
* Prepare and coordinate with other experts monthly project monitoring reports submitted to the ICAO CDI and ICAO EUR/NAT

jobs.description:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.

As a Customer Success Manager, you serve a shared portfolio of customers alongside your teammates rather than owning a named list of your own. Any customer in the pool may be yours on any given day, and your job is to make that experience feel seamless to them.

This is a different craft from named account management. You work from a prioritized queue driven by health signals, product usage, support activity, and renewal proximity. You load context quickly, diagnose accurately, deliver value in a compressed number of touchpoints, and leave the account better documented than you found it so the next teammate can pick up exactly where you left off.

  

You are equally comfortable walking a network operations lead through a product capability and explaining business impact to a director. You thrive on variety and volume, and you take pride in doing high-quality work at pace.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Shared Portfolio Coverage & Customer Engagement**

* Serve customers across a shared portfolio, working from a prioritized queue rather than a fixed account list.
* Deliver proactive lifecycle touchpoints, including onboarding confirmation, adoption checkpoints, and structured pre-renewal reviews.
* Respond to inbound customer needs within team coverage standards and see them through to resolution.
* Build credibility quickly with new stakeholders, often without the benefit of an established relationship.
* Be the voice of the customer internally, using the breadth of the pool to spot patterns a single account view would miss.

**Product & Technical Enablement**

* Guide customers on best practices, implementation planning, and usage optimization.
* Deliver product demonstrations to drive adoption and unlock new use cases.
* Collaborate with Support and Product teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Translate technical capability into business outcomes the customer cares about.

**Value Realization at Scale**

* Execute standardized success plays consistently and well, adapting the message rather than rebuilding the motion.
* Confirm that every customer you touch has clear, documented outcomes they are working toward.
* Connect product adoption to tangible business results in every customer conversation.
* Contribute improvements to the plays themselves based on what you see working in the field.

**Retention, Risk & Renewal Readiness**

* Detect churn risk early through health signals, usage decline, support friction, and stakeholder change.
* Run structured pre-renewal reviews and prepare a clear readiness picture for each upcoming renewal.
* Hand off renewals to the Renewals CSM with complete context, including value delivered, open risks, stakeholder map, and expansion signals.
* Identify cross-sell and up-sell opportunities and route them to Sales with the supporting evidence.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintain rigorous documentation so account context lives in the system rather than in individual memory. This is the foundation of the pooled model.
* Keep data accurate and current in internal systems, including Totango and Salesforce.
* Manage many concurrent customer conversations without letting commitments slip.
* Contribute to team KPIs, including coverage, response time, adoption, health score, and retention.

**What You Bring**

* 2 to 4 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Technical Support, or a similar customer-facing role in B2B SaaS.
* A balance of technical aptitude and business acumen. You can speak both languages. Exposure to networking, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, or infrastructure is an asset.
* Comfort serving many customers at once and prioritizing by signal rather than by relationship history.
* Excellent written communication. A significant share of pooled engagement happens asynchronously, and your writing carries the relationship.
* Strong documentation habits and genuine discipline about leaving a clean trail for teammates.
* Experience delivering demos and running structured customer conversations.
* Familiarity with CS and CRM tooling, such as Totango or Salesforce.
* A proactive mindset: driven, accountable, coachable, and naturally customer-obsessed.

This position offers a base salary range of $87,000 - $110,000 USD per year plus participation in a discretionary bonus plan. Final compensation will be based on skills, experience, and qualifications. The role is for an existing vacancy.

If you share our enthusiasm for the future of our company and are eager to contribute to our vibrant workplace, we look forward to receiving your application!

This position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; tax advantaged accounts (HSA, FSA); annual Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA); a 401(k) with company matching; paid parental leave; vacation, personal, and wellness days; an annual learning and development budget. Eligible employees may also participate in the company's annual bonus program.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Manager
jobs.description:
**Customer Experience Manager**

**Remote.** Open to candidates anywhere in the United States. This is a remote customer experience and customer service leadership role.

Full-time. Pay $72,800 to $93,600 per year

**Before you apply, read these. If any of these are true, this is not the right role for you.**

You have used a customer service platform but have never configured it yourself. You have never built rules, automations, macros, or views.

You cannot point to a specific process you built that saved measurable time or money.

You have never managed or trained direct reports.

Your answer to every customer complaint is a refund.

**About the role**

We are a hemp manufacturer and ecommerce company selling direct to consumers through Shopify and wholesale to businesses. Customer service is handled by a small team covering both channels, and we are looking for the person who will own that function end to end. This role is also commonly titled Customer Service Manager, Customer Support Manager, or CX Operations Manager, and we welcome applicants from any of those backgrounds.

Most of your time will be spent building and optimizing the customer support platform. We run Gorgias as our helpdesk and ticketing system. That means the automations, rules, macros, tags, views, routing logic, chatbot and AI agent configuration, and the self-service resources customers use before they ever open a ticket. You are the technical owner of this stack. You are not just working inside a helpdesk someone else set up. You are the one designing it.

Alongside that, you own the customer experience model itself. You will analyze what our current policies cost us and what they save us, design workflows that protect the business from fraud and abuse, and build a CX program that is genuinely better than standard customer service. We want someone who thinks past the script.

You will also train and lead the team. That includes onboarding new representatives, coaching in real time, running one on ones, and giving direct feedback when something is not working.

**How this role changes over time**

This role changes shape. In the beginning it is heavily focused on setup and build: configuring the platform, designing automations, creating self-service resources, and documenting how the team works. As that foundation gets built, the role shifts toward handling outlier cases, approving the calls the team cannot make on their own, and working more tickets hands-on. We want someone who is excited by both phases, not just one.

**Where your time goes in the first year**

Platform architecture and automation, 35 percent

Service model, policy, and process design, 20 percent

Team leadership, training, and feedback, 20 percent

Hands-on ticket work, 15 percent

Tracking, reporting, and escalating customer feedback, 10 percent

**What you will actually do**

Build, test, and maintain automations, rules, triggers, macros, tags, views, and routing logic.

Audit the existing configuration continuously. Kill what does not fire, fix what misroutes, retire what nobody uses.

Own the AI and intent setup. Decide what the bot answers, what it escalates, and audit its accuracy on a set schedule.

Own customer-facing self-service: help center, FAQs, chatbot flows, contact form, and troubleshooting content.

Analyze what existing policies cost and what they save, and bring recommendations with data behind them.

Build fraud-resistant workflows, including repeat-claim detection and evidence requirements.

Write, refine, and enforce the standard operating procedures the team follows.

Onboard and train new representatives against a documented ramp plan.

Coach to specific examples in real time and hold the team accountable to the process and the numbers.

Work tickets daily alongside your team, and own escalations and complex business-to-business issues.

Report weekly on performance with insight, not just numbers, and escalate urgent issues immediately.

Flag legal, compliance, and regulatory risk when you spot it in ticket language, policy wording, or process gaps.

**What we are looking for**

Provable hands-on experience building inside a customer service or helpdesk platform. Gorgias is strongly preferred. Zendesk, Kustomer, Front, Intercom, or similar will be considered if you have done real configuration work, not just ticket handling.

Experience configuring or auditing an AI agent or chatbot in a support environment.

Experience managing, training, and giving performance feedback to direct reports.

A track record of auditing, creating, and improving customer service policies, with results you can describe.

Comfort with Shopify and ecommerce systems, and the ability to work across fulfillment, finance, and web teams.

Strong writing. Most of our customer communication is written.

**Interview process**

The interview includes technical questions on automation logic and agentic AI workflows. You will be asked to explain in detail how you understand these and to walk through builds you have personally done. You will also be asked for specific examples of coaching a direct report and of a policy you created or improved.

Pay: $72,800.00 - $93,600.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Months of hands-on experience in a CX platform.
* Which CX platforms do you have expert-level experience in, and how long in each?
* Have you built automations of workflow rules from scratch? Interview includes technical questions.
* Months auditing AI agents/chatbot?
* How many reps have you managed at one time?
* Do you have experience auditing, creating, and improving policies? You will be asked to give specific examples.

Work Location: Remote

**About Us:**

Federal Compass is a leading SaaS provider offering a comprehensive suite of business process automation, pipeline management, and opportunity sourcing tools designed to empower Federal contractors. Our mission is to streamline the complex government contracting lifecycle, enabling our clients to identify, pursue, and win more opportunities. We're a high-growth company with a passionate team dedicated to delivering exceptional value and outcomes for our customers.

**Position Summary:**

The Customer Success Manager is a key member of our Customer Success team, responsible for ensuring that a portfolio of clients successfully adopts, uses, and derives maximum value from our platform. This role requires an **entrepreneurial spirit** and a **proactive approach** to problem-solving. You'll serve as the primary point of contact for clients, guiding them through the entire customer journey from onboarding to renewal. You'll be a trusted advisor, helping Federal contractors optimize their business development processes and achieve their growth goals by tailoring your approach to the diverse **personas** you engage with.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Customer Relationship & Portfolio/Project Management***

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a designated portfolio of clients, building and nurturing strong relationships with both **end-users and key decision-makers**.
* Use data from **HubSpot** and other internal tools to **assess the health of your portfolio** and proactively identify at-risk accounts.
* Tailor your communication and engagement strategy to the specific role and needs of each person you interact with, from the day-to-day user to the executive sponsor.
* Act as a customer advocate, ensuring their feedback and needs are heard by internal teams like Product and Engineering.

***Persona-Driven Onboarding & Product Adoption***

* Lead the onboarding process by first identifying the key **personas** and their specific goals.
* Conduct onboarding sessions tailored to each persona's role—for example, focusing on pipeline tracking with a BD Manager and ticket management with an end-user.
* Focus on maximizing **product adoption** from the outset by actively guiding users to key features that align with their business goals.
* Ensure a swift **time-to-value** by helping new clients achieve their first key business outcome quickly.

***Problem-Solving & Support Tickets***

* Manage and resolve incoming **support tickets** from your clients, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
* Tailor your support and troubleshooting approach based on the user's role and technical proficiency.
* Take a self-motivated, proactive approach to anticipating customer needs and identifying potential issues before they arise.

***Revenue Growth & Retention***

* Manage the renewal process for your portfolio of clients by engaging with the appropriate **decision-makers** to demonstrate the product's value and ROI.
* Identify opportunities for **expansion and upsell**, positioning new features or products that align with the client's evolving needs, especially those of the executive personas.
* Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams to highlight the value of our platform and identify new growth opportunities.

***Time Management & Workflow***

* Independently manage your time to ensure the necessary focus is given to onboarding, customer check-ins, and the timely resolution of support tickets.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records and activities within **HubSpot**.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Gross Retention Rate:** Contribute to the team's gross retention rate by managing client relationships and mitigating churn risk.
* **Net Revenue Retention (NRR) / Net Dollar Retention (NDR):** Contribute to the team's NRR by identifying and driving upsell opportunities.
* **Time to Value:** Ensure new clients in your portfolio achieve their first key business outcome quickly.
* **Customer Health Score:** Maintain a high customer health score for your accounts by ensuring consistent engagement and product usage.
* **Product Adoption:** Drive the adoption of key platform features within your client portfolio.
* **Support Ticket Resolution:** Maintain a high customer satisfaction rating on support tickets and meet defined service-level agreement (SLA) targets for resolution time.

**Qualifications:**

***Experience*****:**

* Minimum of [1-2] years of experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Account Management, or a related field within a B2B SaaS environment.
* Proven experience working with a complex business solution (e.g., CRM, business process management software).
* Experience using **HubSpot** or a similar CRM platform to manage customer accounts and track activities is required.
* Use of GovWin or other Opportunity platform is a plus, but not a requirement.
* Experience with the Federal contracting industry is a plus, but not a requirement.

***Skills:***

* A strong **entrepreneurial spirit** and a highly **self-motivated**, proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage a portfolio of clients and prioritize tasks effectively.
* An empathetic and customer-centric mindset with a passion for helping others succeed.
* Ability to use data and analytics to inform your client strategy.

**What We Offer:**

* $60,000-$80,000 base, additional potential $10,000-$30,000 bonus
* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
* 401(k) plan with company match.
* Generous paid time off and holidays.
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth within the Customer Success team.
* A collaborative, mission-driven, and supportive work environment.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $70,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

jobs.title: Clinical Care Manager
jobs.description:
It’s an exciting time to join the WellSense Health Plan, a growing regional health insurance company with a 25-year history of providing health insurance that works for our members, no matter their circumstances.

  

**Job Summary**

The **Clinical Care Manager** provides holistic clinical care management services for members across the continuum of care through comprehensive assessment, care planning, education, care coordination, advocacy, and ongoing monitoring. The Clinical Care Manager works collaboratively with members, families, providers, community organizations, and multidisciplinary care teams to improve health outcomes, promote self-management, address barriers to care, and ensure appropriate utilization of healthcare services.

Utilizing telephonic outreach, virtual engagement, data analysis, and face-to-face visits, the Clinical Care Manager conducts assessments, develops individualized care plans, coordinates services, and promotes member engagement through evidence-based practices and motivational interviewing techniques. * Educate members and caregivers regarding disease processes, preventive care, treatment plans, medication adherence, and self-management strategies.

* Provide health education using culturally appropriate and health literacy-sensitive materials.

* Support members in understanding and navigating healthcare benefits, services, and available community resources.

**Care Coordination and Population Management**

Working closely with sales representatives, dealers, designers and internal teams, you’ll help deliver tailored product solutions across commercial, educational, healthcare and public sector environments.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Coordinate with Product Management, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance and Customer Service to confirm product configurations, pricing accuracy and project feasibility.
* **Process Improvement & Support:** Serve as a resource for contract pricing and technical product questions while identifying opportunities to improve quoting processes, compliance practices and supporting systems.

  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Interior Design, Architecture or a related field or equivalent relevant industry experience.
* 2–4 years of experience in the contract furniture industry, preferably in quoting, sales operations, product support or a related role.
* Working knowledge of contract furniture products, including modular furniture systems, casegoods, seating and ergonomic office solutions.
* Familiarity with GSA contracts, SLED (state, local and education) purchasing agreements, cooperative purchasing programs and dealer or distributor pricing structures.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with quoting tools and ERP/CRM systems, such as Syteline and Pipeline.
* Strong analytical organizational and communication skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Ability to interpret product specifications, collaborate across departments and translate customer requirements into practical product solutions.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with CET Designer, 2020 CAP or other furniture specification tools.
* Experience with Syteline or a comparable ERP system.
* Ability to interpret floor plans, finish schedules and technical product documentation.
* Understanding of dealer and distributor workflows within the contract furniture industry.

  

**Who We Are**

HAT is a rapidly growing designer and manufacturer of monitor mounting solutions, height-adjustable tables and other ergonomic office products with a diverse global customer base. We specialize in custom manufacturing and pride ourselves on innovative solutions, exceptional product quality and outstanding customer service.

  

Headquartered in Easton, PA, we also have offices and showrooms in Santa Clara, Los Angeles, New York City, Chicago and Denmark. At HAT, we believe our people are our greatest asset and we foster a collaborative environment focused on continuous improvement, innovation and employee success.

  

**Why Join HAT?**

**Our comprehensive rewards package includes:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Employee assistance and wellness programs
* Opportunities for professional growth and development

  

At HAT, we value hard work, collaboration and creative problem-solving. If you’re ready to help deliver innovative furniture solutions while supporting the success of our sales team and customers, **apply today!**

**Title:** Product Administration and Support Manager

**Level:** Senior

**Job-Type**: Full Time

**Location(s)**: Remote

**About the Company:**

HLP Integration is a leading provider of data and document management solutions, specializing in tailored technologies that leverage machine learning and artificial intelligence. We work with commercial and government clients to identify critical information that facilitates conclusive business decisions with accuracy and efficiency.

HLP Integration is a dynamic small business with a diverse and inclusive team, where every employee collaborates directly with senior leadership. We take pride in fostering an environment where all voices are heard, innovation is encouraged at every level, and everyone can chart their own career course. At HLP Integration, we believe in the power of collaboration, and our close-knit culture allows us to deliver personalized solutions and exceptional service to our clients. As a proud supporter of veterans both on our team and in our work, we are committed to providing opportunities for those who have served our country and we value the unique perspectives they bring to our team.

* Gather, analyze, prioritize, and document customer and business requirements for current and future products, enhancements, and feature improvements.

* Participate in the product demonstration process and provide feedback to ensure professional, polished presentations.
* Support the development and implementation of product management best practices, processes, and governance across the organization.
* Assist in managing product roadmaps, feature requests, and customer feedback to support strategic product decisions.

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Management Information Systems, or a related field required.
* Relevant certifications in Product Management, Agile, Scrum, ITIL, or related disciplines are a plus.

new_jobs.title: Instructional Designer
new_jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 175065
  
  
**Job Category:** Human Resources
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** People
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Livermore
  
  
Department Overview
  
Known as the People team, the Human Resources (HR) and the Enterprise Change Office (ECO) together, joyfully deliver expertise, resources, and solutions to positively impact our coworkers, company, partners, and hometowns in achieving amazing outcomes.
  
  
Position Summary
  
PG&E Academy is looking for an Instructional Designer to join our PG&E Academy Curriculum Development Team in support of Electric Operations learning needs. This role works closely with the development team and clients to develop and maintain the learning content, tools, systems, and programs that support our employee’s ability to safely and efficiently perform their work and job tasks. This is accomplished via a wide range of methodologies, delivery mechanisms and formats to meet specific business needs. The Instructional Designer will work closely with subject matter experts as well as internal and external stakeholders to translate business and performance objectives into learning and performance support solutions and to ensure that employees are trained to competence.
  
  
The successful candidate should have a proven track record in design and development. The Instructional Designer must have excellent written and verbal communication skills. The candidate should have strong organizational skills and possess the ability to analyze data and consult with client groups.
  
  
This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need.
  
  
PG&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors.​
  
  
**A reasonable salary range is:** ​
  
**Bay Area Minimum:** $80,000
  
**Bay Area Maximum:** $120,000​
  
  
Job Responsibilities Conduct needs analysis, design curriculum and develop training content and materials utilizing various training tools, methods, approaches and tactics within PG&E’s quality standards. Provide input regarding learning solution and estimate of work. Collaborate and consult with project partners and stakeholders to design and develop learning solutions that reinforce business goals and best practices. Facilitate content development sessions with subject matter experts and stakeholders, under the guidance of more experienced learning professional. Identify key metrics for measuring training effectiveness, aligning training results with business goals and metrics. Manage time and tasks and escalate challenges appropriately.
  
  
Qualifications
  
**Minimum:** Bachelor's Degree in Instructional Design, Liberal Arts, or related degree/ field, or equivalent work experience. 3 years of Instructional Design, communications, teaching, training, change management, or graphic design work experience
  
**Desired:** Knowledge of Microsoft Office Products, i.e., Word, Excel, PowerPoint- as needed to perform at the job level. Knowledge of e-learning and video development/ editing, including tools such as Author-it, Questionmark, Smart Media World (SMW), and Articulate Storyline . Strong communication, collaboration, facilitation, organization, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively with subject matter experts and stakeholders. Ability to travel locally up to 20%.
